requirement_en: Given two unsigned 64-bit integers, return the greater value without overflow or mutation.
Given two unsigned 64-bit integers, return the smaller value.
Given a value and an inclusive valid range, return the value clamped into that range.
Given two unsigned integers whose sum fits in u64, return their sum.
Given two unsigned integers where the subtrahend is not larger, return their difference.
Given an unsigned integer smaller than u64::MAX, return it plus one.
Given a positive unsigned integer, return it minus one.
Given two unsigned integers, return their absolute difference without underflow.
Given two unsigned integers whose sum fits in u64, return floor((x + y) / 2).
Given two unsigned integers, subtract the second from the first, returning zero on underflow.
Given an Option<u64>, return true exactly when it contains a value.
Given an Option<u64>, return true exactly when it is None.
Given an Option<u64> and a default, return the contained value or the default.
Given an Option<u64>, increment the contained value when present and safe, otherwise keep None.
Given a u64, return Some(x) exactly when x is nonzero, otherwise None.
Given a boolean and value, return Ok(value) when the boolean is true and Err otherwise.
Given a Result<u64, ()>, return true exactly when it is Ok.
Given a Result<u64, ()> and a default, return the Ok value or the default.
Given two unsigned integers, return Some(sum) when addition fits in u64 and None otherwise.
Given two unsigned integers, return Ok(x / y) when y is nonzero and Err when y is zero.
Given an immutable borrowed Vec<u64>, return its length without mutation.
Given an immutable borrowed Vec<u64>, return true exactly when its length is zero.
Given a nonempty borrowed Vec<u64>, return its first element without mutation.
Given a nonempty borrowed Vec<u64>, return its last element without mutation.
Given a borrowed Vec<u64> and a valid index, return the indexed element.
Given a borrowed Vec<u64> and an index, return Some(element) for in-bounds indices and None otherwise.
Given a borrowed Vec<u64> and a default, return the first element when present and the default otherwise.
Given a borrowed Vec<u64> and a default, return the last element when present and the default otherwise.
Given a borrowed Vec<u64> and a target, return true exactly when some element equals the target.
Given a borrowed Vec<u64>, return true exactly when every element is nonzero.
Given a borrowed Vec<u64>, return true exactly when at least one element is zero.
Given a borrowed Vec<u64> with at least two elements, return the second element.
Given a uniquely borrowed Vec<u64>, a valid index, and a value, update exactly that element.
Given a uniquely borrowed Vec<u64> and two valid indices, swap the two elements and leave all others unchanged.
Given a uniquely borrowed Vec<u64> and a value, append the value to the vector.
Given a nonempty uniquely borrowed Vec<u64>, pop and return the last element.
Given a uniquely borrowed Vec<u64>, index, and value, update the element only when the index is in bounds and report whether an update happened.
Given a uniquely borrowed Vec<u64>, pop the last element when present and return it as an Option.
Given a uniquely borrowed Vec<u64> and two values, append both values in order.
Given a uniquely borrowed Vec<u64> and a value, set every element to that value.
Given a uniquely borrowed Vec<u64> and a valid prefix length, set the prefix to zero and leave the suffix unchanged.
Given immutable source and uniquely borrowed destination vectors where destination is long enough, copy all source elements into the destination prefix and leave the rest unchanged.
Given a uniquely borrowed Vec<u64> whose elements can all be incremented, add one to every element.
Given a uniquely borrowed Vec<u64> and a value, set the first element only when the vector is nonempty and return whether it changed.
Given owned Vec<u64>, consume it and return its length.
Given an immutable borrowed Vec<u64>, return an owned clone with the same sequence of elements.
Given an immutable slice of u64, return its length without indexing.
Given a nonempty immutable slice of u64, return its first element.
Given a borrowed fixed-size array of length three and a valid index, return the indexed element.
Given a uniquely borrowed fixed-size array of length three, valid index, and value, update exactly that array position.
Given an unsigned 64-bit integer, return true exactly when it is even.
Given an unsigned 64-bit integer, return true exactly when it is odd.
Given an unsigned 64-bit integer whose double does not overflow, return twice the value.
Given an unsigned 64-bit integer whose square does not overflow, return its square.
Given three unsigned 64-bit integers, return the greatest of the three values.
Given three unsigned 64-bit integers, return the least of the three values.
Given a signed 32-bit integer and lower and upper bounds with low at most high, clamp the value into that inclusive range.
Given a signed 64-bit integer, return true exactly when it is nonnegative.
Given two unsigned 64-bit integers whose product does not overflow, return their product.
Given two unsigned 64-bit integers with sum not overflowing, return the floor midpoint.
Given an optional unsigned integer whose contained value can be doubled without overflow, return an option containing twice the value when present and None otherwise.
Given an optional unsigned integer, return its contained value when present and zero otherwise.
Given an optional unsigned integer, return true exactly when it is Some containing zero.
Given a Result containing an unsigned integer or error code, and every Ok value can be incremented without overflow, return Ok(value+1) for Ok and preserve Err.
Given a Result containing an unsigned integer or error code and a default value, return the Ok value when present and the default on Err.
Given two unsigned integers, return Some(x-y) when x is at least y and None otherwise.
Given two unsigned integers, return Ok(x % y) when divisor is nonzero and Err(x) when divisor is zero.
Given two optional unsigned integers, return the first option when it is Some, otherwise return the second option.
Given a Result containing an unsigned integer or error code, return true exactly when it is Err.
Given an optional unsigned integer, return the same Some value only when it is even, and None for absent or odd values.
Given an immutable vector of unsigned integers with length greater than two, return the third element.
Given an immutable vector of unsigned integers and a bound, return true exactly when the vector length is at least the bound.
Given an immutable vector and a limit, return true exactly when every element is strictly less than the limit.
Given an immutable vector and a limit, return true exactly when at least one element is greater than the limit.
Given an immutable vector with length at most u64::MAX, return the number of zero elements.
Given an immutable vector of length two whose two elements sum without overflow, return the sum of its elements.
Given an immutable vector of length two, return true exactly when the first element is at most the second.
Given an immutable vector and index, return the element at the index when in bounds and zero otherwise.
Given two immutable vectors, return true exactly when their lengths are equal.
Given an immutable slice of unsigned integers with positive length, return its last element.
Given a uniquely borrowed vector, remove all elements.
Given a uniquely borrowed nonempty vector and a value, update exactly the last element to that value.
Given a uniquely borrowed vector and value, push the value only when the vector is initially empty.
Given a uniquely borrowed vector, pop one element exactly when the initial length is greater than one.
Given a uniquely borrowed vector with at least two elements and a value, update exactly the second element.
Given a uniquely borrowed nonempty vector, swap exactly the first and last elements.
Given a uniquely borrowed nonempty vector whose first element can be incremented without overflow, increment exactly the first element.
Given a uniquely borrowed vector, append one zero element.
Given a uniquely borrowed vector, keep only the first element when initially nonempty and leave empty vectors empty.
Given a uniquely borrowed vector, set every element to zero without changing the length.
Given a uniquely borrowed fixed-size array of length three and two valid indices, swap exactly those two positions.
Given an immutable fixed-size array of length three, return its first element.
Given an immutable fixed-size array of length three, return its last element.
Given an immutable fixed-size array of length three whose elements can be summed without overflow, return the sum of all elements.
Given an immutable slice, return true exactly when it is empty.
Given an immutable slice and a valid index, return the element at that index.
Given a uniquely borrowed fixed-size array of length three and a value, update exactly the first position.
Given a uniquely borrowed fixed-size array of length three and a value, update exactly the last position.
Given an immutable fixed-size array of length three, return true exactly when all three elements are zero.
Given an immutable fixed-size array of length three, return true exactly when at least one element is zero.
